summary_zh: Orkas 是一款开源（MIT）、本地优先的桌面多智能体应用。指挥官把目标拆成待办，协调 16 个内置专家智能体，以及 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 智能体协作，并通过项目、定时自动化和连接器推进工作，覆盖视频、图片、研究报告、内容、代码、Office 文件与电商等任务。
audience_zh: 适合希望用多个智能体持续承接跨天工作、重视数据和自有密钥保存在本机、需要内容制作/研究/代码/Office/电商等多种交付物的个人与小型团队；不适合只想要单一聊天机器人或纯代码库嵌入的开发者。

Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first multi-agent desktop app — an AI assistant that works as a team. Tell the **Commander** what you need: it finishes many tasks on its own, and for bigger work it plans the steps and brings in specialist agents along with the coding and personal agents you alr

Orkas is built to keep a project moving, not just answer one prompt. A **project** holds the goal, rules, memory and files, so every new conversation picks up where the last one left off. **To-dos** split the work between people and agents, **Auto-advance** lets the team take on the next to-do by it

self, and **scheduled automations** repeat routine work hourly, daily, weekly or monthly. All your data stays on your computer, and finished work comes back for your review — so you can trust Orkas with the ongoing work of your business.
